## EOS interface and dispatch (`type`) {#sec-ch02-interface}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** N/A (a factory): the EOS key `type` selects one of five concrete types, each implementing a set of tensor conversion keys; an unsupported key fails at dispatch.
**Data.** In: YAML `dynamics/equation-of-state` with `type` and the floors. Out: the EOS module whose conversion keys the rest of the step may call (the table in the Numerical method layer).
**Placement.** At option construction; the selected module is called at every conversion.
**Activation.** `type` defaults to `moist-mixture`; the moist types require thermo options.
**Guarantee / limits.** A factory; no discretization order or single defining equation. Selecting an EOS also selects which downstream operations exist.
**Evidence.** `test_hydro_options.release` (unknown dynamics keys rejected, exception); `test_eos.release` (selected EOS behaviour, per type; see the per-type sections).
:::

The EOS factory selects a set of tensor conversion operations. Unsupported keys fail at dispatch, so selecting an EOS also selects which downstream operations are available. The factory key is `type`.

### Derivation

No physical derivation applies to dispatch. The caller and selected implementation must agree on both key
and tensor representation. `W` denotes primitive state, `U` conserved state, `I` internal energy density,
`T` temperature, `A` adiabatic index, `L` sound speed, `K` kinetic energy density and `E` species energy density.
These are API labels, not additional mathematical symbols.

### Numerical method

Dispatch is pointwise on cell tensors, including ghost entries passed by the caller; it performs no halo exchange.

| key family | ideal gas | moist types | ANEOS | shallow water |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `W->U`, `U->W` | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `W->I`, `UT->I` | yes | yes | yes | throws unknown abbreviation |
| `W->T` | yes | yes | yes | undefined tensor |
| `W->A`, `WA->L` | yes | yes | no | index undefined; speed yes |
| `W->E`, `U->K` | no | yes | no | no |
| `W->L`, `WL->A` | no | no | yes | no |

: Supported conversion branches, as cited in each type's Code layer. {#tbl-ch02-interface-keys}

Unknown keys throw. YAML validates map structure and known keys. A present EOS map supplies `gammad=1.4`,
`weight=0.029` in $\mathrm{kg\,mol^{-1}}$, density floor $10^{-6}$ in $\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$,
pressure floor $10^{-3}$ in $\mathrm{Pa}$, temperature floor $20$ in $\mathrm K$, `limiter=false`,
and empty `eos-file`. If the map is absent, the struct defaults remain: density and pressure floors are both
$10^{-10}$ in their respective units. Moist resets replace `gammad` and `weight` from their thermo.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Temperature-floor positivity and finiteness are not validated in `from_yaml`. Selecting the default moist EOS
without thermo options fails during reset. ANEOS and shallow water do not satisfy the full moist API.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
